subject: planner: support using hint to create hypo-indexes (#54517)
summary: Changes HYPO_INDEX hint-generated hypothetical indexes to resolve each hinted column to its actual table column offset via infoschema, instead of using hint position (pkg/util/hint/hint.go:290, pkg/planner/optimize.go:610). Verified planner still only considers hypo-index hints for EXPLAIN statements (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:1120); no Blocker/High issues found.
